flashcard_questions.q: The capacity to do work. In nutrition, energy is measured in kilocalories (kcal) or kilojoules (kJ) and comes from the macronutrients in food.
The amount of energy the body uses at complete rest to maintain basic life functions such as breathing, circulation, and cell repair.
A number that represents how physically active a person is. It is multiplied by BMR to calculate total daily energy needs.
BMR accounts for the largest portion of your daily energy use — typically _____ of total energy expenditure

flashcard_questions.a: The relationship between energy consumed from food and drink (energy in) and energy used by the body for activity and body functions (energy out).
